prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1176; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The vehicle shows a side impact to the driver's door, rear quarter panel, and adjacent rocker area, with crush and paint transfer consistent with the reported intersection collision. Most of the damage lines up well with the impact described. Repairs are planned as door and quarter panel replacement, with refinishing and a sensor recalibration. The labor hours look a little high for this scope, so a line-by-line review is suggested. The invoices show no repeated charges. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records.
